privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how Kalima handles account, learning, marketplace, and support data.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect account details, contact information, learning activity, order details, uploaded payment proof, and support messages needed to operate Kalima.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use data to provide access, process purchases, manage teacher and student workflows, secure accounts, and respond to support requests.

sections.title: Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell personal data. We share data only with service providers or administrators who need it to operate the platform.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can request correction or deletion of your account data by contacting Kalima support.

dataDeletion.title: Delete My Data
dataDeletion.intro: Request deletion of your Kalima account and associated personal data.
dataDeletion.requestBody: We will verify your identity, review required retention obligations, and confirm when eligible data has been deleted.
steps: Send your request from the WhatsApp number or email linked to your account.
Kalima support verifies ownership and any active orders or access records.
Eligible personal data is deleted or anonymized, then confirmation is sent to you.
notes: Some transaction, tax, fraud-prevention, or legal records may need to be retained.
Deleted accounts may lose access to courses, e-booklets, orders, and support history.
dataDeletion.whatsappMessage: Hello, I want to request deletion of my Kalima account and associated data.
